payload.blocks: Phase 2 land (the .fgos write witness). The finished change waits uncommitted in worktree forgent-worktrees/261124-1945-run-tests-fgos-leak-check-p02.
payload.headline: Widen the run-tests leak plan footprint by three test files that call runTests with a fake spawn?

parts.cause: The unit (unit-run-1795586714970-56f99249) ran those three files: they call runTests/runSelectedTests with a fake spawn that never loads the witness, so the runner correctly reports no witness. run-tests.test.mjs already fixes its own callers with a small wrapper (asWitnessedSpawn) that writes the witness load line. No running plan claims the three files.

options.cost: About 30 test lines in 3 files, one fix unit, about 30 minutes.
options.does: Add the three test files to the plan footprint; a fix unit wraps their fake spawns like asWitnessedSpawn.
options.gain: AC3 stays as planned; the leak check fails closed on a broken preload.
options.harm: Three more files in this plan's footprint.
options.label: Widen footprint by the three files

options.cost: About 20 lines removed in run-tests.mjs and its test.
options.does: Remove the no-witness failure; a run with no witness record passes with nothing attributed.
options.harm: A broken witness preload would silently pass every leak check, which the plan's Risks call out.
options.label: Drop fail-closed (AC3)

options.does: Leave the change in the worktree; the stopgap list stays on main.
options.harm: The land gate keeps failing on live writes outside the stopgap list.
options.label: Park the phase

parts.recommendation: Widen the footprint by the three files: the fix is mechanical, reuses the wrapper that already exists, and keeps the fail-closed guard the plan was approved with.

scope.allows: Adding exactly test/scripts/full-suite-queue.test.mjs, test/scripts/test-select.test.mjs and test/scripts/run-test-canary.test.mjs to this plan's footprint, and a fix unit that edits only their fake spawns.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change, changing the tests' assertions, or any flag or env switch that skips the leak check.

parts.what: Phase 2 is implemented: a write witness replaces the LIVE_FGOS_DIRS list, and the leak cases (AC1-AC3) pass. But the fail-closed rule (AC3: a run where no test process loaded the witness fails) now fails 7 cases in three test files outside the footprint: test/scripts/full-suite-queue.test.mjs, test/scripts/test-select.test.mjs and test/scripts/run-test-canary.test.mjs.
